items.title: How Costco is keeping shoppers coming back as K-shaped economy widens
items.summary: Mizuho Americas Director & Senior Analyst David Bellinger joins Josh Lipton on Market Domination to discuss Costco (COST) Q4 earnings and how the company is using its tariff rebates to manage pricing strategy to protect value and keep customers loyal.

items.title: How GLP-1 weight-loss drugs are changing fast-food menus
items.summary: Chipotle, McDonald's and Shake Shack are among the restaurant chains revamping their menus as more consumers go on weight-loss drugs.

items.title: A Quick Bite On EAT Stock: How We Avoided A Bad Aftertaste In Brinker
items.summary: If you dine at a Chili's restaurant and leave before the bill comes, that's bad behavior. But if you buy Chili's parent Brinker International, lock in quick profits and walk away before the stock turns? That's disciplined swing trading.

items.title: How Much Should One Number Worry Starbucks Shareholders?
items.summary: If you own Starbucks (SBUX), the headline revenue number can mislead you. Revenue fell 1.4% from a year earlier in the latest quarter, its only drop in four quarters, but Starbucks said the decline came mainly from turning its China stores into a licensed joint venture. Comparable store sales rose 7.9%, though management said close to half of that came from store closures, sales transfers, and delivery. items.title: McDonald’s Will Wiggle Its Way Out of Today’s Classic Economic Squeeze…Eventually
items.summary: McDonald's has shed a fifth of its value in 2026 while its franchise machine keeps printing billions in free cash flow, and that tension puts investors in an uncomfortable spot where both buying and selling carry a real cost.

items.title: McDonald’s CEO says high inflation will last ‘many more years’ — but there’s a McLimit to how much people will tolerate
items.summary: After years of price increases, McDonald’s is trying to win back cost-conscious customers as lower-income diners pull back on spending.

items.title: How McDonald’s plans to reactivate 150M infrequent loyalty guests
items.summary: The Golden Arches will add rewards tiers, tie-ups with other major brands and increased personalization to its loyalty system.

items.title: McDonald’s turns to AI for drive-thru, inventory management, order accuracy
items.summary: McDonald’s will roll out ArchIQ, an artificial intelligence platform to power restaurant operations, as part of its Next strategy.
